data.title: 伊地知虹夏 · 练习室闷热后的冰饮贴颈
data.description: 密封隔音练习室里连敲了三个小时双踩，闷热的空气让虹夏香汗淋漓。运动背心紧紧贴在起伏的胸口，碎发濡湿在颈窝。当少年将冰镇红茶贴在她脖颈动脉上时，虹夏打了个激灵笑着缩起脖子，顺势抓住少年的手掌贴在自己发烫的心口上。
data.action: cooling neck with cold can, laughing, pulling hand to chest, sweating
data.promptProse: Catching her breath in the humid rehearsal studio after hours of drumming, Ijichi Nijika laughs cutely as a cold beverage can touches her sweaty neck. In her blue athletic tank top, she playfully pulls the viewer's hand against her chest with flushed cheeks.
data.animaCaption: Nijika laughing breathless in the drum studio cooling her neck with a soda.
